# Mawsool Actors on Apify

Mawsool publishes LinkedIn and email data Actors on Apify. Exact matches only. No LinkedIn login and no cookies. You supply the email or the URL.

## People

- Fix Broken LinkedIn URLs. Old, stale, or broken profile URL in, current profile URL out. Use it when a saved LinkedIn link 404s after a name change or a custom URL edit. Recovery on stale lists is often up to 70%. A miss is free. Review matchType likely before you replace the URL. exact and confident are safe to replace. Starting from $1 per 1,000 recovered. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-fix-broken-linkedin-urls
- Reverse Email Lookup. Email address in, LinkedIn profile out, exact match only. Starting from $0.60 per 1,000 emails. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-email-linkedin-lookup
- LinkedIn Profile Finder. Name and company in, profile URL out. Starting from $0.40 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-finder
- LinkedIn Email Finder. Profile URL in, personal email out, only on a 100% exact match. No match, no charge. Starting from $30 per 1,000 found. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-personal-email-finder
- Profile Freshness Check. Profile URL in, current company and headline out. You compare them to your CRM. This Actor does not decide if they match. Starting from $0.40 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-freshness
- LinkedIn Profile Scraper. Full profile from a URL you already have. Starting from $0.80 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-details
- Mass Profile Scraper. The same full profile, for large URL files. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-mass-linkedin-profile-scraper
- Job Change Tracker. Scheduled alert when the employer or headline changes. Starting from $0.30 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-job-change-watch
- Current Company Checker. Compares a company you supply with the current employer. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-company-checker
- Profile to Company Website. Starting from $0.70 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-to-company-website
- Work Experience. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-experience
- Education. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-education
- Certifications and Patents. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-credentials
- Certification Checker. Yes or no for one certificate. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-certification-checker
- Profile Activity. Likes and comments. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000. https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-activity
